import torch
import torch.nn as nn

DT = torch.float16
ROWS, COLS = 16384, 8192  # 128M elements; fp16 in/out -> ~512 MB of ideal HBM traffic


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Row-wise fused normalization chain on a [ROWS, COLS] fp16 tensor:
      LayerNorm(x) -> per-column gated quick-GELU -> residual mix -> RMS re-normalize -> scale
    Three row reductions (mean, var, mean-of-squares) + a long elementwise chain,
    all computed in fp32 and written back as fp16. Purely bandwidth/reduction bound.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.eps = 1e-5
        dev = "cuda"
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)
        ln_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(COLS, generator=g)
        ln_b = 0.1 * torch.randn(COLS, generator=g)
        gate = 1.0 + 0.2 * torch.randn(COLS, generator=g)
        res_w = 0.5 + 0.1 * torch.randn(COLS, generator=g)
        out_w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(COLS, generator=g)
        self.ln_w = nn.Parameter(ln_w.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.ln_b = nn.Parameter(ln_b.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gate = nn.Parameter(gate.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.res_w = nn.Parameter(res_w.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.out_w = nn.Parameter(out_w.to(dev, dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        xf = x.float()
        # LayerNorm (biased variance), fp32 statistics
        mu = xf.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        xc = xf - mu
        var = (xc * xc).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        h = xc * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps) * self.ln_w.float() + self.ln_b.float()
        # per-column gated quick-GELU
        a = h * torch.sigmoid(1.702 * (h * self.gate.float()))
        # residual mix
        r = h + a * self.res_w.float()
        # RMS re-normalization + output scale
        inv_rms = torch.rsqrt((r * r).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)
        out = r * inv_rms * self.out_w.float()
        return out.to(x.dtype)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1)
    x = torch.randn(ROWS, COLS, generator=g, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
    x = (x * 1.5 + 0.3).to(DT)
    return [x]

N_ROWS = 32768   # batch * seq_len
HIDDEN = 4096    # hidden size


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Fused row block: RMSNorm -> affine -> SiLU -> column gate -> residual mix -> row log-softmax.
    Three row reductions (sum of squares, max, sum-exp) plus an elementwise chain over a
    large [N, H] fp16 tensor with fp32 math. Optimal traffic is one read + one write of x."""

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
        w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        b = 0.05 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        gate = 0.5 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(w.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(b.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gate = nn.Parameter(gate.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.eps = 1e-5
        self.res_scale = 0.5

    def forward(self, x):
        # x: [N, H] fp16
        xf = x.float()
        ms = xf.square().mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)              # reduction 1
        xn = xf * torch.rsqrt(ms + self.eps)

        y = y * self.gate.float() + self.res_scale * xf           # gate + residual

import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

N_TOKENS = 32768   # batch * seq_len
HIDDEN = 4096      # model width
EPS = 1e-5
ALPHA = 0.5


def _device():
    return torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Row-wise fused chain on a [32768, 4096] fp16 activation:
        LayerNorm(x) -> affine -> GELU(tanh) -> sigmoid-gated residual with x
        -> RMSNorm -> affine -> fp16
    Three dependent row reductions (mean, variance, mean-of-squares) interleaved
    with elementwise math. Ideal traffic is read-x-once / write-y-once (~512 MB),
    so the op is HBM-bandwidth bound.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = _device()
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)

import torch.nn as nn

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Fused token-wise block on a [tokens, hidden] fp16 activation matrix:
    # LayerNorm (mean/var row reductions) -> affine -> gated GELU -> residual
    # -> RMSNorm (row reduction) -> output scale. All math in fp32, output fp16.
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        hidden = 4096
        self.eps = 1e-5
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)

        def mk(t):
            return t.to(device="cuda", dtype=dt)

        self.register_buffer("ln_w", mk(1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(hidden, generator=g)))
        self.register_buffer("ln_b", mk(0.05 * torch.randn(hidden, generator=g)))
        self.register_buffer("gate_w", mk(1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(hidden, generator=g)))
        self.register_buffer("gate_b", mk(0.1 * torch.randn(hidden, generator=g)))
        self.register_buffer("out_w", mk(1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(hidden, generator=g)))

    def forward(self, x):
        xf = x.float()
        mean = xf.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        xc = xf - mean
        var = xc.square().mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        h = xc * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)
        h = h * self.ln_w.float() + self.ln_b.float()
        a = nn.functional.gelu(h, approximate="tanh")
        s = torch.sigmoid(h * self.gate_w.float() + self.gate_b.float())
        r = xf + a * s
        ms = r.square().mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        y = r * torch.rsqrt(ms + self.eps) * self.out_w.float()
        return y.to(x.dtype)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1234)
    return [torch.randn(65536, 4096, device="cuda", dtype=DT, generator=g)]

    Fused row-wise normalization + gated activation + residual + row-max rescale.
    Pure memory/reduction-bound chain on a [ROWS, HIDDEN] fp16 tensor:
      mean / var reductions -> affine -> silu*tanh gate -> residual -> amax rescale.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.eps = 1e-5
        dev = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)
        w = 1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        b = 0.05 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(w.to(device=dev, dtype=dt))
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(b.to(device=dev, dtype=dt))

        xf = x.float()
        mean = xf.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        xc = xf - mean
        var = xc.square().mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        xn = xc * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)
        y = xn * self.weight.float() + self.bias.float()
        z = torch.nn.functional.silu(y) * torch.tanh(xn) + xf

import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

N_TOKENS = 16384   # e.g. batch 8 x seq 2048
HIDDEN = 4096      # gate/up width; x carries [gate | up] -> 2*HIDDEN columns


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Fused FFN epilogue on a large 2-D activation tensor:
      x[:, :H] = gate pre-activation, x[:, H:] = up projection
      h = clamp(gate) * sigmoid(alpha*clamp(gate)) * (clamp(up) + 1)   (clamped SwiGLU, elementwise chain)
      y = LayerNorm(h) * w + b                                        (row reduction: mean/var + normalize)
    Per row: read 2*H fp16, write H fp16 -> purely bandwidth-bound.
    """
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.eps = 1e-5
        self.alpha = 1.702
        self.limit = 7.0
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
        w = 1.0 + 0.05 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        b = 0.02 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(w.to(device=DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(b.to(device=DEVICE, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        gate, up = x.chunk(2, dim=-1)
        gate = gate.float().clamp(max=self.limit)
        up = up.float().clamp(min=-self.limit, max=self.limit)
        h = gate * torch.sigmoid(self.alpha * gate) * (up + 1.0)
        y = F.layer_norm(h, (HIDDEN,), self.weight.float(), self.bias.float(), self.eps)
        return y.to(x.dtype)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(1234)
    x = torch.randn(N_TOKENS, 2 * HIDDEN, generator=g, device=DEVICE, dtype=DT)
    return [x]

import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16

# 8 sequences x 2048 tokens, hidden width 8192 (GPT-3 / LLaMA-65B class)
N_TOKENS = 8 * 2048
HIDDEN = 8192
EPS = 1e-5


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Fused pre-norm block tail, one memory-bound row kernel:

        u = LayerNorm(x) * gamma + beta        (row stats over last dim, fp32)
        h = GELU_erf(u)
        y = h * sigmoid(gate) + x * alpha      (per-feature gate / residual scale)

    fp16 in / fp16 out, all arithmetic in fp32.
    Ideal HBM traffic = one read + one write of the [N_TOKENS, HIDDEN] activation.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
        gamma = 1.0 + 0.05 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        beta = 0.05 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        gate = 0.5 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        alpha = 0.9 + 0.05 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g)
        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(gamma.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.beta = nn.Parameter(beta.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gate = nn.Parameter(gate.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.alpha = nn.Parameter(alpha.to(device=dev, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.eps = EPS

    def forward(self, x):
        xf = x.float()
        mean = xf.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        xc = xf - mean
        var = (xc * xc).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        xn = xc * torch.rsqrt(var + self.eps)
        u = xn * self.gamma.float() + self.beta.float()
        h = F.gelu(u)  # exact (erf) GELU
        y = h * torch.sigmoid(self.gate.float()) + xf * self.alpha.float()
        return y.to(x.dtype)

    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    x = torch.randn(N_TOKENS, HIDDEN, device=dev, dtype=DT)

      LayerNorm (mean/var reductions) -> affine -> tanh-GELU -> per-column scale

    Reads x once and writes y once when fully fused; every op in between is

            (1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(self.hidden, generator=g)).to(device=device, dtype=dt)
        )
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(
            (0.05 * torch.randn(self.hidden, generator=g)).to(device=device, dtype=dt)
        )
        self.scale = nn.Parameter(
            (0.5 + torch.rand(self.hidden, generator=g)).to(device=device, dtype=dt)

        super().__init__()

        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)
